items.title: Dominic James "Nick" La Rocca Interview, 1958-05-26
items.q: You had the Darcy brothers With the Clam Big Seven And they clad the jazz band in 1919

ctx.x: Who is Red Brown? Tom Brown

Tom Brown That's what they call him, Red Brown That's what I know about They came back They may have went to Chicago And they broke up with other bands We were still packing them in It's a funny thing that the northern men who began copying the music from the Dixieland Jazz Band was to make good You had Ted Lewis, I don't say he played good jazz I don't say he ever played jazz But they were trying to copy You had Earl Fuller You had Ross Garland You had Vince Lopez The Memphis Five The Indiana Five All people…

Could you I hate to interrupt you again But as you go along Could you give me the details on the records you made I'd like to hear about the What you did for Columbia and how that happened Well on the Columbia
